name: Anna-Maja Henriksson - § 27 - Am 6
title: REPORT on the implementation and streamlining of EU internal market rules to strengthen the single market
part_text: 27. Welcomes the Commission’s planned fitness check on the legislative *acquis* in the digital policy area; demands that the Commission assesses and clarifies the legislative framework and the interplay between current EU legal acts, such as the Digital Services Act9, the General Data Protection Regulation10, the Artificial Intelligence Act11, the Regulation on the Transparency and Targeting of Political Advertising12, the Product Liability Directive13, e-commerce and cybersecurity rules, and between these acts and future legislative initiatives before their adoption by the Commission; insists that regulators, networks of national authorities and stakeholders be involved in this process and stresses that the results of this mapping exercise should serve to identify potential overlapping, contradictory provisions and potential enforcement conflicts and address these shortcomings; in addition, it should serve to improve coordination between enforcement authorities across the Member States and to improve the ability of businesses to invest and innovate in the EU; calls on the Commission to include, where necessary and justified by impact assessments, proposals for simplification in the envisaged digital package, aimed at increasing coherency, legal clarity and predictability for all stakeholders, without undermining agreed policy objectives; calls on the Commission to refrain from proposing new legislative proposals before the fitness check has been completed; urges the Commission, in the context of the Digital Services Act review to be carried out by 17 November 2025, to assess more generally the impact of risk assessment and mitigation measures on respect for freedom of expression;
